newsitem.title: POLAND: Pole charged with spreading child sex on Internet.
newsitem.headline: Pole charged with spreading child sex on Internet.

text.p: Prosecutors have charged a young man with disseminating child pornography on the Internet, the first such incident in Poland, police said on Monday.

The man, in his early twenties, allegedly used a computer at his workplace to send pornographic pictures of children over the Internet, said Alicja Hytrek, the police spokeswoman of the southern Katwice province, where the incident took place.
"This is the first case involving charges of spreading child pornography on the Internet in Poland," Hytrek told Reuters by telephone.

The Internet, used mostly in universities only several years ago, is becoming increasingly popular in the former Soviet bloc country, with the developent of telecommunications facilities and growing ownership of personal computers.

Hytrek said the police had launched an investigation into the case after an Internet discussion group in Sweden discovered child sex pictures on its pages and notified the local network administrator.
"After getting the information from Sweden... we localised the computer used for the dissemination of the picures," Hytrek said.
She added it was too early to say what the man's motives were.
She said the police had detained five people during the investigation but the prosecutor pressed charges only against one. She said it was too early to give more details.
